entities.name: Piedro
entities.description: An old man who rushed in to save Issabela's son before being decapitated by Khalid.
entities.quote: An old man rushed in — Piedro, now grey and fragile. “Run, boy!” The boy froze. Khalid turned slowly, grinned... Then sliced off Piedro’s head in a flash, let it roll in front of the child.

entities.name: The Guardian
entities.description: Liam's father and guardian who fought Khalid for the Architect's Cube before passing it to John.
entities.quote: The Guardian — Liam’s father — saw it coming. Khalid came to claim the Architect’s Cube. The Guardian and Liam fought with all they had.

entities.name: Fahad
entities.description: A boy in whom the blue fist power reappears years later.
entities.quote: The dragon-slayer? Still missing. But that blue fist? It reappears... in a boy named Fahad.

updates.new_facts: Cruel figure who erased a runner's name, tortured a Hidden One and his family, desecrated Issabela's grave, fought Norman and cursed him into a vampire, battled John and Liam, and cursed the dragon-slayer.
updates.quote: Khalid didn’t just kill him. He ripped his legs off mid-run, watched him crawl for help, and said: “You called this speed? This is crawling, little rat.”

updates.new_facts: One of three close brothers-in-arms alongside John and Liam; fought Khalid and was cursed by him into a vampire doomed to drink blood.
updates.quote: Enter: Norman — one of three close brothers-in-arms alongside John and Liam. When Norman hears Khalid is nearby, he doesn’t wait.

updates.new_facts: One of three close brothers-in-arms, received the Architect's Cube from the Guardian, fought Khalid and unleashed a red lightning spark before suffering a mortal wound.
updates.quote: John, Liam, Norman — now scattered. The Guardian — Liam’s father — saw it coming. Khalid came to claim the Architect’s Cube.

updates.new_facts: Brother-in-arms alongside John and Norman; fought alongside his father and John against Khalid, awakening his full ancient magic power after John fell.
updates.quote: John alone fights him — then Liam joins. But Khalid is a beast. Magic means nothing. Rage isn’t enough.

updates.new_facts: A fragile boy with too much rage and pain whom Khalid's surviving soul waits to find.
updates.quote: Until it finds a fragile boy with too much rage, too much pain... Robin.

updates.new_facts: Her grave in Istanbul was visited by Khalid, who disparaged her memory in front of her son and Piedro.
updates.quote: Khalid, years later. Weakened, tired — but still twisted. He wandered into Istanbul and found Issabela’s grave. A young boy knelt in front of it — her son.

updates.new_facts: Referred to as a dead god by Khalid in front of a Hidden One assassin.
updates.quote: Not for interrogation. But because he hated the way the man looked at him — like he still believed in Zaan.

timeline_events.title: The First Comet's Murder
timeline_events.description: Khalid brutally murders a nameless runner known as the first comet on the streets.
timeline_events.quote: It starts with a man who could run like thunder. His speed split the streets. Some called him the first comet. He had no name in history... Because Khalid erased it.

timeline_events.title: The Hidden One's Family Massacre
timeline_events.description: Khalid captures a Hidden One assassin in a burnt chapel, allows his family to be assaulted, and burns them alive.
timeline_events.quote: Next, Khalid found a Hidden One assassin hiding in a burnt chapel. Captured him alive. Not for interrogation.

timeline_events.title: The Desecration at Issabela's Grave
timeline_events.description: Khalid insults Issabela at her grave in Istanbul and decapitates Piedro in front of her son.
timeline_events.quote: Khalid, years later. Weakened, tired — but still twisted. He wandered into Istanbul and found Issabela’s grave. A young boy knelt in front of it — her son.

timeline_events.title: The Birth of the Vampire Norman
timeline_events.description: Norman fights Khalid in an alley, takes a chunk from his shoulder, but is stabbed and forced to ingest Khalid's blood, becoming a vampire.
timeline_events.quote: Enter: Norman — one of three close brothers-in-arms alongside John and Liam. When Norman hears Khalid is nearby, he doesn’t wait.

timeline_events.title: The Death of the Guardian and Passing of the Cube
timeline_events.description: The Guardian dies fighting Khalid for the Architect's Cube and passes it to John.
timeline_events.quote: The Guardian — Liam’s father — saw it coming. Khalid came to claim the Architect’s Cube. The Guardian and Liam fought with all they had.

timeline_events.title: John's Last Stand and Liam's Awakening
timeline_events.description: John fights Khalid, unleashes a red lightning spark, and falls, prompting Liam to awaken his ancient magic and blast Khalid away.
timeline_events.quote: John alone fights him — then Liam joins. But Khalid is a beast. Magic means nothing. Rage isn’t enough.

timeline_events.title: Encounter with the Dragon Slayer
timeline_events.description: A weakened Khalid enters a bar and confronts a silent man with a blue glow under his knuckles who cracks a table in half.
timeline_events.quote: Khalid, now weakened, bleeding, drained — limps into a filthy bar. He drinks. Laughs. And sits beside a silent man with a blue glow under his knuckles.
